motion.rules: Never apply transition: all. Avoid layout shifts. Use Motion/React for card entrance and modal backdrops.
motion.stagger_delay: stagger direct children by 0.05s on grid mount

accessibility.wcag_target: WCAG AA (4.5:1 text contrast on all surfaces)
accessibility.test_attributes: All buttons, inputs, tabs, modal triggers, and result items MUST include semantic data-testid in kebab-case (e.g. data-testid='generate-studio-btn', data-testid='upload-slot-front', data-testid='spec-product-name-input')

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. PALETTE & AESTHETIC: Strictly adhere to the requested Warm Beige (#E9E1D5), Cream (#F8F5F0), Muted Brown Accent (#9B8264), Charcoal Text (#252525), and Off-white canvas (#FCFBF9). Do not use pure black (#000000) or cold blue gradients. The app should feel like a bespoke, luxury Apple-standard personal tool for an Indonesian creator/entrepreneur.

2. LANGUAGE & LOCALIZATION: Use natural Indonesian for all primary navigation, greetings, studio steps, spec helpers, and workspace tabs (e.g. 'Studio Produk AI', 'Ruang Kerja Saya', 'Pengaturan Agen', 'Kategori Produk', 'Unggah Foto Asli', 'Sumber Kebenaran Spesifikasi'). Keep English for product style names and technical AI keys where appropriate.
3. TIMEZONE & GREETING: Display Indonesian time (WIB - Waktu Indonesia Barat) and contextual greetings: 'Selamat Pagi' / 'Selamat Siang' / 'Selamat Sore' / 'Selamat Malam' based on current hour.

4. AI PRODUCT STUDIO (MAIN FEATURE): Build a polished, rich 8-step generator. 1) Category selector (6 categories); 2) Multi-slot upload grid (Front, Side, Top, Bottom, Detail, Lighting reference) with drag-drop or file selection simulation + image previews; 3) Product Spec Form with dedicated 'SOURCE OF TRUTH' explanatory card; 4) Photography Style picker with visual thumbnail cards; 5) Scene customizer with 6 presets + prompt input; 6) Quantity selector (1, 2, 4, 8); 7) Generate button with live mock simulation (realistic 2.5s progress bar with simulated steps: 'Menganalisis sudut foto...', 'Menyesuaikan pencahayaan...', 'Merender tekstur...'); 8) Rich result gallery with image zoom, original-vs-generated comparison slider, download, favorite, delete, and add to project folder.

5. MOCK MODE BY DEFAULT: Unless user inputs a custom API key in Settings, the app operates in full, high-fidelity DEMO / MOCK mode with persistent local state (localStorage + backend motor db). Clearly display a neat 'DEMO MOCK MODE' chip on studio results and settings so the user is aware.

6. 5 MODULAR AI AGENTS: Include the full directory of 5 agents (AI Product Studio, Daily Assistant, Finance Assistant with IDR calculator, Learning Assistant, Creative Assistant). Each has its own dedicated workspace drawer/tab with interactive simulated capabilities.
7. MY WORKSPACE & SETTINGS: Provide complete workspace organization (filter generated images, create projects, view history) and Settings (API key configuration, profile, theme).
8. TESTING: Ensure EVERY button, tab, input, select, and modal has explicit data-testid attributes.
